properties.name: Working a proof hole is scored on its preserved search as well as its result, and a fresh reader restates the search from the design alone
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-30 ("Go with your recommendations", option (d) of dec:idea-the-preserved-search-is-a-deliverable-of-working-a-proof-hole)
properties.statement: Increment 5 reports, beside whether the hole closed: how many routes were recorded with the step and reason they fail; how many changes of route name the source or result that caused them; how many methods were stated apart from the problem. A fresh agent that never saw the work restates the search (routes, obstacles, turns) from the design alone, and that restatement is checked against the record.
